# ReactDOOM

The built, playable site for ReactDOOM, DOOM with its screen drawn by React:
https://ryancolton.github.io/ReactDOOM/

This repository holds only the build output and is published automatically from
the source repository. The engine is a TypeScript port of the original DOOM
source (https://github.com/id-Software/DOOM, via
https://github.com/kant003/doomJavascript), licensed GPL-2.0 (see LICENSE.TXT).
The complete corresponding source for this build, including the React
presenters, is available on request from the repository owner, as the license
requires.
